title_en: Registration for Graduate Research Students, Fall Semester (2nd Semester) of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: Graduate students who have completed their coursework and who meet one of the conditions listed in the notice must register as research students by paying a fee of KRW 200,000 within one of two registration periods. Registration is not possible after the periods end.
applies_to: Graduate students who have completed their coursework (수료생) and who meet condition A, B or C below. Current enrolled students (재학생) are not affected. Students expected to complete their coursework in August 2026 who meet A, B or C must also register. (A) Those who have completed a graduate programme and wish to use university facilities (library, laboratories and practice rooms, graduate research rooms, Gwanak Residence Halls, etc.) or submit a degree thesis in the 1st semester of the 2026 academic year, as written in the notice; without research student registration, an application for thesis examination is not possible (doctoral preliminary examination is still possible). (B) Those who will work as lecture/research support scholarship students or work-study scholarship students in the 2nd semester of 2026 after completion; these students must register in the 1st registration period. (C) Those participating in the BK Plus programme after completion, or who are principal investigators or participating researchers on a research project; registration is mandatory.

dates.what: 1st registration (payment) period; mandatory period for lecture/research support and work-study scholarship students
Earliest payment date for students completing coursework in August 2026

dates.when: Monday 14 September 2026, 09:00 to 28 September 2026 (given as Tuesday in the notice), 17:00

steps: Check that you are a student who has completed coursework (or will complete it in August 2026) and that you meet condition A, B or C in the notice. If you are a lecture/research support or work-study scholarship student, you must register in the 1st period.

Print your payment bill: log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → 학사/정보 (Academic/Information) → 등록 (Registration) → 고지서/내역조회 (Bill/History Inquiry) → select '연구생부담금고지서' (Research Student Fee Bill) and print it.

Pay KRW 200,000 within a registration period, either (1) at any branch of NH NongHyup Bank or Shinhan Bank using the printed bill, or (2) by bank transfer to the personal virtual account shown on the bill. Payment is possible 24 hours on weekdays, but closes at 17:00 on the last day. No separate application is required beyond payment.

If you need proof of payment, log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → 학사/정보 (Academic/Information) → 증명/확인서 (Certificates/Confirmations) → 증명/확인서 발급 (Issue Certificate/Confirmation) to issue a payment confirmation.
For refund applications and other details, refer to the attached files, or contact the department office (contact details are in the original notice).
translation:
Registration for Graduate Research Students, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
Posted: 5 August 2026

※ If you do not register within the registration period, additional (late) registration is not possible.

1. Eligible students
Among graduate students who have completed their coursework (수료생), only those who fall under A, B or C below should register.
★ This does not apply to currently enrolled students (재학생)! Students expected to complete their coursework in August 2026 who fall under A, B or C must register!

A. Those who have completed a graduate programme and who wish to use university facilities (library, laboratories and practice rooms, graduate research rooms, Gwanak Residence Halls, etc.) or to submit a degree thesis in the 1st semester of the 2026 academic year [as written in the notice].
※ If you do not register as a research student, you cannot apply for thesis examination (the doctoral preliminary examination is still possible).

B. Those who will work as lecture/research support scholarship students (강의연구지원장학생) or work-study scholarship students (근로장학생) in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year after completion must register in the 1st registration period.

C. Those participating in the BK Plus programme after completion, or those who are principal investigators or participating researchers on a research project: research student registration is mandatory.

2. Registration periods
A. 1st period: Wednesday 19 August 2026, 09:00 to Wednesday 2 September, 17:00 ★ Check the dates!!
※ Students completing their coursework in August 2026 can pay from Tuesday 1 September.
※ Payment is possible 24 hours a day on weekdays (closes at 17:00 on the last day).

B. 2nd period: Monday 14 September 2026, 09:00 to 28 September (given as Tuesday in the notice), 17:00 (final) ★ Check the dates!!
※ Payment is possible 24 hours a day on weekdays (closes at 17:00 on the last day).

3. Amount: KRW 200,000 (two hundred thousand won)

4. Place and method of payment (※ There is no separate application procedure other than payment.)
A. Place: any branch of NH NongHyup Bank or Shinhan Bank
B. Method:
Method 1) Pay at a designated bank using the system-printed payment bill.
Method 2) Pay by bank transfer to the personal virtual account stated on the payment bill.

5. How to print the payment bill
Log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → 학사/정보 (Academic/Information) → 등록 (Registration) → 고지서/내역조회 (Bill/History Inquiry) → select '연구생부담금고지서' (Research Student Fee Bill) and print it.

6. Issuing a payment confirmation
Log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → 학사/정보 (Academic/Information) → 증명/확인서 (Certificates/Confirmations) → 증명/확인서 발급 (Issue Certificate/Confirmation).

7. For refund applications and other details, please refer to the attached files.

● Enquiries: the department office (학부행정실), Building 301, Room 319. The staff contact details are given in the original notice.
